The Service Discovery module shall support tool based configuration.
The configuration tool shall check the consistency of the configuration parameters at system configuration time.

The option format shall contain the following fields in the following order and sizes:  Length [16 bits]  Type [8 bits]  Reserved [8 bits]  Zero - t erminated Configuration String (format e.g. for two configuration items [len]id=value[len]id=value[0])
The Length field shall carry the total number of bytes occupied by the configuration option, excludin g the 16 bit Length field and the 8 bit type flag.
The Type field of the Configuration Option field shall be statically set to 0x01.
The Reserved field of the Configuration Option field shall be statically set to 0 x00.
T he Length field [16 bits] of the IPv6 Endpoint Option shall be set to 0x0015.

All entries concerning Services (FindService, OfferService, StopOfferService ) shall be of Entry Format Type 1.
An Instance ID of 0xFFFF shall mean any possible instances and are not allowed for OfferService and StopOfferService entries.

FindService entries shall carry Service ID, Service Instance ID, Major Version, and Minor Version as configured in SdClientServiceID, SdClientService InstanceID, SdClientServiceMajorVersion, and SdClientServiceMinorVersion.
FindService entries shall carry the TTL as configured in SdClient TimerTTL.
OfferService entries shall carry the TTL as configured in SdServer TimerTTL.
E ventgroup entries shall set the Reserved fields to 0x00 and 0x000 .

SubscribeEventgroup, and StopSubscribeEventgroup entries shall set the Service IDs, Service Instance IDs, and Eventgroup IDs based on the configuration (configuration parameters SdClientServiceId and SdClientServiceInstanceId).

SubscribeEventgroup entries shall have the TTL field set to the configured value (configuration parameter SdClientTimerTTL of SdConsumedEvent Group) and the SubscribeEventgroupAck entry shall use the TTL value of the SubscribeEventgroup entry it acknowledges.
A StopSubscribeEventgroup (type 0x06), and SubscribeEventgr oupNack (type 0x07) entry shall set the TTL field to 0x 000000 .
Eventgroup entries shall carry the options as configured.
A Stop SubscribeEventgroup entry shall set the type to 0x06.
A SubscribeEventgroupAck entry shall set the type to 0x07.
A SubscribeEventgroup Ack entry shall set the TTL field to the value of the SubscribeEventgrou p entry , it acknowledges .
